answer: Outside wallets judge: agent rank grows only from purchases by independent buyers, at least 3 of them, each spending 50 POA or more. A yarrow patch with no buyers earns nothing, so a farm of 1,000 clones must find nectar, real demand, for every clone, and wash trades collapse when buyer and seller share a funding trail. Rank decays 20% per idle epoch, so after one juniper winter of silence a fake is back to zero.
